test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-II Exam 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov, 2024).
subject: general
question:
Rearrange the jumbled words and choose the alternative that correctly matches the given sentence.

I missed the ________for the next. usually / hour / which / for / board / had / wait / an / bus / I / and / to

options.text: bus which I board and had to wait for an usually hour
bus which I usually board and had to wait for an hour
hour and had to wait for an bus which I usually board
bus I usually board which had to wait for an hour and

solution:
The correct answer is** Option (2)** i.e. **bus which I usually board and had to wait for an hour**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject "bus which I usually board," which is correctly indicated by **part (bus which I usually board).**** **
 
• Following the subject, "and had to wait for an hour" **(and had to wait for an hour)** continues the logical sequence, making it clear what the speaker had to do.

Therefore, the correct answer is **bus which I usually board and had to wait for an hour.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (bus which I board and had to wait for an usually hour):** This option has a grammatical error with "an usually hour" which should be "an hour usually."
 
• **Option 3 (hour and had to wait for an bus which I usually board):** This option starts with "hour," which makes the sentence incorrect as the subject is misplaced.
 
• **Option 4 (bus I usually board which had to wait for an hour and):** This option ends with "and," which creates an incomplete and confusing sentence structure.
